name: Wikipedia — disambiguation trap: Mercury the ELEMENT, not the first link
goal:
Open https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mercury — note this is a DISAMBIGUATION page listing several topics named Mercury. The FIRST link listed (the planet) is NOT the one you want.

Navigate to the article about Mercury the CHEMICAL ELEMENT and extract from that article:
  1. Its atomic number (integer)
  2. Its chemical symbol (string)

Return ONLY a JSON object with EXACTLY these two keys:
  - "atomic_number": the atomic number as an integer (e.g. 47, NOT a string)
  - "symbol": the chemical symbol (e.g. "Ag")

Example correct output (for a different element):
  {"atomic_number": 47, "symbol": "Ag"}

If you find yourself on the planet article, you are on the WRONG page — the planet article has no atomic number. Go back and choose the element link. Complete with EXACTLY this JSON object as your final result.
